About
NackSgro

Born and raised in Bangkok on December 7, 2000, NackSgro (แน็คสโกร) is a singer-songwriter whose life has been harmonized by music since his earliest years.

His artistic foundation was built on a series of vocal competitions starting in primary school, which later evolved into a deep-rooted commitment within his secondary school’s international music ensemble from Grade 7 through Grade 12. This decade-long immersion in performance and theory ignited a profound passion for vocal artistry and instrumental composition.

Now creating under DarkroomWhiteroom, NackSgro has entered a new era of creative refinement. While his debut EP in 2021 marked a significant milestone in his career, he has since taken a deliberate and curated approach to his digital catalog—selectively retiring earlier works to ensure his public discography perfectly reflects his current artistic vision and elevated standards.

With a focus on emotive storytelling and professional growth, NackSgro is poised for a transformative year. New singles and highly anticipated projects are set to be unveiled throughout 2026.
